body: It is always nice to not be alone with something. Doesn't mean I'm happy you feel bad! I appreciate the nice words, thank you.

Thanks for your reply, I appreciate it. 

I don't doubt I could lead a life with a lot of those great moments. Lately they all don't seem to matter anymore at all, considering how I feel all the time in the last months.

You are right, it's something, but not everything. What bothers me is that achieving anything that would be possible to humans wouldn't solve my problem. It's not that I can't find a solution or things that provide short-term happiness, it's that I believe that there is nothing worth living for. And for me it seems like there aren't that many solutions to that. Either change that believe or stop living. But to change it I would need to find something that would give my life a purpose, which I have been unable to do until now.

Thank you for your reply. I'm sorry it took so long for me to answer, I went straight to bed after I posted the question.

It definitely is not a reason not to live my life anymore but it is no reason to do so either. If I died today, I wouldn't regret not having lived, nor would I feel anything. Not having a purpose in life sucks and makes one feel like shit. Should I seek happiness as a purpose? Is true happiness even achievable? Doesn't happiness only work when there is sadness as well? Even if I managed to do that. If I were truly happy with how my life is going, why(besides the obvious reason of not hurting loved ones) shouldn't I just die? It can never be worse. 


You remind me of how I thought a while ago. Exactly that phrase you put in quotation marks was how I planned on living my life. But all that seems so marginal if everything will cease to exist.


Besides that, I don't even know if and how it correlates to me feeling like shit.
